{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for thousands separators in `revenue`
print("Sample of revenue values:")
print(sales['revenue'].head(10))

# Check if any revenue values contain commas
has_commas = sales['revenue'].str.contains(',', na=False)
print(f"\nRows with commas in revenue: {has_commas.sum()}")

# Show the first few rows with commas
print("\nFirst few rows with commas:")
print(sales[has_commas].head())"}
